svg.title: Task Offloading Framework - Class Diagram (ROS2 Jazzy / Python)

g.text: Task Offloading Framework - Class Diagram (ROS2 Jazzy / Python)
In code this maps to rclpy base classes:
Both inherit the full ROS2 comms interface (publishers/subscribers,
service server + client, action server + client). LifecycleNode also
adds the managed lifecycle state machine + on_* transition callbacks.
node_id is NOT a stored field: it is passed to the rclpy constructor
as the node name and read back via get_name().
destroy_node() is a ROS2 (rclpy) built-in on the node that frees its
resources; OffloadManager.teardown_node() deregisters the node and then
calls the node's destroy_node() (Manager owns the reference from
"source" and "target" are ROLES here, per migration.
They are NOT stored on OffloadableNode. Any node can
be a source in one migration and a target in another.
location is an open id (vehicle / edge / cloud / other DT).
